icons.instructions: Use lucide-react (already installed) for all UI icons. Keep stroke-width consistent (1.5 or 2).

instructions_to_main_agent: Install `lenis` for smooth scrolling in the landing page.
Include `Hind Siliguri` (Bengali) and `Chivo` (English/Display) from Google Fonts in the HTML head.
Implement the landing page in standard React/Tailwind components, using Framer Motion for scroll reveal animations.
For the admin panel, rely on Shadcn UI components (Table, Dialog, Select, DropdownMenu) heavily.
Ensure all interactive elements have `data-testid` attributes as specified in rules.
The sticky mobile bar should only appear on mobile devices (md:hidden) and contain 'Call' and 'Order' actions.
Forms must handle basic validation before showing a success state (mocked order submission).
